title: Majagi — TIBNLA Constitution Act 2022
description: The Constitution Act of Majagi — TIBNLA, dated 22 May 2022 and prepared by the Elder Council under the Original Lore/Law of the Land. Sets out the Preamble, Basic Principles of the Nation, Civil and Human Liberties, the National Home of the Tiwi, Brinkin and Larrakia People, the Mayaar of the Nation, the Lore/lawful Authority, the Executive Authority, the Judiciary, the Nation Comptroller, and the status, ratification and amendment of the Constitution.

title: TIBNLA — Private Members Articles of Association (May 2022)
description: Original Private Members Articles of Association (PMA) of TIBNLA (Tiwi-Brinkin-Larrakia) Cultural Organisation, dated May 2022. Establishes the unincorporated association, its members, purpose, powers and By-Lores, founded on first-in-time customary lore on Country and the custodial protection of land, air and water.

title: Majagi / TIBNLA — Allodial Title Registration, Tiwi Islands (TIB0002)
description: Recording TIB0002 issued by the Allodial Land Use Registry on 12 June 2024 in favour of TIBNLA Nation (Registration No. UPU# RRR160601169AU). Records Allodial Land & Maritime Use Permit over the Tiwi Islands — the third largest islands off the Australian coast, north of Darwin, NT — with a parcel area of 833,549.5 hectares.

title: Majagi / TIBNLA — Allodial Title Registration, Sea Boundary 200nm (TIB0003)
description: Recording TIB0003 issued by the Allodial Land Use Registry on 12 June 2024 in favour of TIBNLA Nation. Records Allodial Land & Maritime Use Permit over the sea boundary of TIBNLA Nation, extending 200 nautical miles from the shorelines, excluding the Tiwi Islands land mass — covering 5,467,535 hectares (approx. 18,956 square nautical miles) of sea.

title: Proclamation of Independence — Majagi
description: Public Notice of Proclamation of Independence by Juma Samuel Fejo of the Larrakia Majagi Tribe, asserting ancestral rights and tribal lore under the principle "first in time, best at law". Includes the Royal Bloodline Lineage of the Bilby and the Quoll (FEJO Family) and Statement of Claim against the NT Government (2024).

title: Customary Law Notice — UTCLA (January 2023)
description: Official notice issued on the 6th day of January 2023 (Ref MTT000555) by the United Tribal Countries Land Alliance, documenting the Custodial Tribal High Court proceedings, findings on lawful standing of Original Tribal Countries, and trademark registrations lodged with TIBNLA Patent and Trademark Office for Member Nations.

title: Grandmother Lore Notice (December 2023)
description: Official Lore Notice issued 4 December 2023 (Instrument No. DSDAUSJP130-20231204-1601-GM-001) by Grandmothers Lore — the superior Lore/Law on the aniuima (land) of the Continent known as Terra Australis. Includes open letter to Heads of State, letter to WIPO and IP Australia, and the Statement of Truth of Juma of the Larrakia.

title: Original Traditional Sovereign Nationals — Rights over Land, Seas & Airways (February 2026)
description: Declaration affirming the rights of Original Traditional Sovereign Nationals over the land, seas and airways of Terra Australis, issued February 2026.

title: Letter from the Russian Ambassador — Alexey Pavlovsky (August 2023)
description: Official correspondence dated 16 August 2023 from Ambassador Alexey Pavlovsky of the Embassy of the Russian Federation to Craig-Richard Oldroyd, Head of State/Ambassador of Majagi. The Ambassador expresses Russia's respect and sympathy for the Majagi Nation and all Aboriginal Nations of Terra Australis, confirms the Embassy is exploring ways to engage with the Majagi Nation, and attaches the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs Report on the Human Rights Situation in Australia.

title: Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Human Rights Situation in Australia
description: Report by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation on the Human Rights Situation in Certain Countries — Australia section. Provided as an attachment to the August 2023 letter from Ambassador Pavlovsky. Documents systemic human rights concerns including the treatment of Aboriginal peoples, incarceration rates, land rights violations, and the ongoing failure to remedy discrimination against Indigenous communities.

title: Treaty — TIBNLA & Subanen Tribe Acopiado Clan 1750, Philippines (12 August 2025)
description: Treaty Agreement executed 12 August 2025 between Majagi Larrakia 1600 Countries Societatum of TIBNLA (Country A) and the Subanen Tribe Acopiado Clan 1750 of the Opirian Kingdom of the Philippine Islands (Country B). Signed by H.M. Juma Samuel Fejo, H.E. Dennis Merosevich and H.E. Dato Sriram Venugopal for TIBNLA, and H.M. Abel Tria Adorable and H.M. Mercedita Sumagang Acopiado for the Subanen Tribe. Compliant with Articles 1, 3.1 and 7 of the Vienna Convention on Treaties between States.

title: Treaty — TIBNLA & Kaurareg Nation, Kaiwalagal Plenum Dominium (14 August 2025)
description: Treaty Agreement entered into on 14 August 2025 between Majagi Larrakia 1600 Countries Societatum of TIBNLA and the Kaurareg Nation, Kaiwalagal Plenum Dominium (Seisia, QLD). Compliant with Articles 1, 3.1 and 7 of the Vienna Convention for Treaties between Nation States, affirming the principle of First in Time Best at Lore/Law.

title: Treaty — TIBNLA, Pintupi Wati Tjuta Tjungarinyi & Nyamal Widajurra Country (23 August 2025)
description: Trilateral Treaty Agreement entered into on 23 August 2025 between Majagi Larrakia 1600 Countries Societatum of TIBNLA, the Nations of the Pintupi Wati Tjuta Tjungarinyi (Kintore, NT) and the Nyamal Widajurra Country (Jingili-Larrakia, NT). Compliant with Articles 1, 3.1 and 7 of the Vienna Convention for Treaties between Nation States.

title: Treaty — TIBNLA & Vanua Ko Viti (Fiji) (23 August 2025)
description: Treaty of Cultural Recognition and Socio-Economic Development entered into on 23 August 2025 between Majagi Larrakia 1600 Countries Societatum of TIBNLA and Vanua Ko Viti (Fiji), Nausori, Suva. Establishes mutual recognition, a Joint Cultural Commission, a Bilateral Development Fund and frameworks for trade, education, arts, tourism and sustainable development. Compliant with Articles 1, 3.1 and 7 of the Vienna Convention on Treaties between States.

title: Treaty — TIBNLA, Pintupi Wati Tjuta Tjungarinyi & Adnyamathanha Tribal Nation (26 August 2025)
description: Trilateral Treaty Agreement entered into on 26 August 2025 between Majagi Larrakia 1600 Countries Societatum of TIBNLA, the Nations of the Pintupi Wati Tjuta Tjungarinyi (Kintore, NT) and the Adnyamathanha Tribal Nation (Forreston, SA). Compliant with Articles 1, 3.1 and 7 of the Vienna Convention for Treaties between Nation States.

title: Treaty — TIBNLA, Pintupi Wati Tjuta Tjungarinyi & Kunjen Olkol Country (27 August 2025)
description: Trilateral Treaty Agreement entered into on 27 August 2025 between Majagi Larrakia 1600 Countries Societatum of TIBNLA, the Nations of the Pintupi Wati Tjuta Tjungarinyi (Kintore, NT) and the Kunjen Olkol Country (Sea Hawk People, Kallangur, QLD). Compliant with Articles 1, 3.1 and 7 of the Vienna Convention for Treaties between Nation States.

title: Treaty — TIBNLA, Pintupi Wati Tjuta Tjungarinyi & Ni'ripono Gwata Tu Sovereign Government (19 September 2025)
description: Trilateral Treaty Agreement entered into on 19 September 2025 between Majagi Larrakia 1600 Countries Societatum of TIBNLA, the Nations of the Pintupi Wati Tjuta Tjungarinyi (Kintore, NT) and the Ni'ripono Gwata Tu Sovereign Government (Weipa, QLD). Compliant with Articles 1, 3.1 and 7 of the Vienna Convention for Treaties between Nation States, affirming the principle of First in Time Best at Lore/Law.

title: Lawful Standing — Customary Flag Law Ceremony (1 January 2023)
description: Photographic record of the Customary Flag Law Ceremony restating customary land claim on Country, held on 1 January 2023. Juma of the Larrakia with the Majagi flag.

title: Elders Gathering on Country (June 2023)
description: Photographic record of Elders gathered on Country in June 2023, preparing and marking traditional materials as part of customary ceremony and lore practice — documenting living cultural authority and intergenerational custodial work.
